# Systems-Analysis.ru

> Multilingual reference and knowledge website with two complementary content layers: a static public HTML site of curated articles, literature, publications, and source materials; and Russian, English, and international MediaWiki knowledge bases. Core subjects include systems theory, systems analysis, operations research, decision theory, modeling, management, systems engineering, methodology, mathematics, data science, artificial intelligence, and large language models.

This file is a detailed routing layer for language models and agents. Select the user's language first, then select the content layer and the subject. Use the static public site for authored overviews, classical methodologies, literature pages, publications, and stable thematic reading paths. Use the wiki branches for encyclopedic expansion, section catalogs, semantic networks, literature indexes, categories, terminology, and multilingual discovery.

Russian content uses the public root and `/wiki/`; English content uses `/en/` and `/eng/`; Spanish combines `/es/` with the Spanish master catalog in `/int/`; Japanese combines `/ja/` with the Japanese master catalog in `/int/`; other languages primarily use `/int/`, language categories, and language-specific sitemap routes. Russian, English, and Spanish have developed static article trees. The Japanese static branch is under construction: it already provides the full set of navigation pages and a growing number of articles, so prefer a `/ja/` page when it exists and fall back to `/int/` otherwise. Several other languages have compact public landing pages, but a language listed in the global sitemap must not be assumed to have a complete static article tree.

Choose the routing structure by task: use a section catalog for a curated subject overview; a semantic network for concept relationships; a literature page for sources and further reading; a category for broad discovery of all classified pages; a local static map for the authored article hierarchy; a language sitemap for language-specific routing; and XML sitemaps only for exhaustive crawling. AI and LLM content is one peer subject branch within the wider systems-analysis architecture and must not be treated as the default route for unrelated requests.

For downloadable full-text books and source collections, use the dedicated Russian static catalogs at `/systems_analysis_book.html` and `/operation_research_book.html`; these pages group book files by subject and supplement them with related literature, annuals, network-planning materials, articles, and presentations. For language-wide discovery in the international wiki, use direct MediaWiki category routes in the literal form `/int/Category:<English_language_name>`, for example `/int/Category:Spanish`. The top-level `/int/Category:Language` route enumerates the individual language categories. A language category is a broad classification index and may contain more, fewer, or less curated pages than the corresponding master language catalog.

To determine the current number of pages available in a language, consult the corresponding language category or the relevant XML sitemap. A MediaWiki language category reports its current total membership above the paginated list even when only the first 200 entries are displayed. For machine-readable enumeration, count the page URL records in the applicable XML sitemap: use `/wiki/sitemap.xml` for the Russian wiki, `/eng/sitemap.xml` for the English wiki, and `/int/sitemap.xml` for the international multilingual branch. For one language inside `/int/`, prefer `/int/Category:<English_language_name>` as the direct per-language count because `/int/sitemap.xml` inventories the entire international branch. Do not assume that a language-category total and an XML-sitemap total are identical: a category counts pages explicitly assigned to that language, whereas an XML sitemap follows its own indexing and inclusion rules.

The `.md` resources listed below are navigation sitemaps, not Markdown versions of content pages. Content pages are HTML or MediaWiki pages. Routing structure reviewed against the site's global, Russian-wiki, English-wiki, international-wiki, and local static maps on 2026-08-22.

Markdown content negotiation: any HTML content page on this domain — the static public site and all wiki branches — can be retrieved as Markdown by sending the request header `Accept: text/markdown`; the response is served with `Content-Type: text/markdown`. Only this Accept header triggers conversion; appending `.md` to page URLs is not supported.

## Global multilingual and content-layer routing
- [Global human-readable sitemap](https://systems-analysis.ru/sitemap.html): Primary overview of public language editions, static maps, wiki branches, language catalogs, project resources, and crawler indexes.
- [Global semantic sitemap](https://systems-analysis.ru/sitemap.md): Machine-oriented router to language-specific navigation files, deep branch maps, directories, and XML indexes; this is a sitemap file rather than a content-page conversion.
- [Public-site language navigation](https://systems-analysis.ru/languages.html): Language selector for the developed Russian, English, and Spanish static public editions.
- [Russian wiki deep HTML map](https://systems-analysis.ru/sitemap/sitemap_wiki.html): Structured map of Russian wiki entry points, peer subject catalogs, semantic networks, literature pages, and detailed category indexes.
- [English wiki deep HTML map](https://systems-analysis.ru/sitemap/sitemap_eng.html): Structured map of English wiki entry points, peer subject catalogs, semantic networks, and literature pages.
- [International wiki deep HTML map](https://systems-analysis.ru/sitemap/sitemap_int.html): Multilingual map of 27 master language catalogs, translated section catalogs, language categories, topic categories, and meta-categories.
- [Multilingual HTML sitemap](https://systems-analysis.ru/multilingual_map.html): Cross-language HTML sitemap connecting sections, articles, and their language versions.

- [Russian static site map](https://systems-analysis.ru/map.html): Hierarchical index of the seven principal static branches and their individual articles.
- [Russian books](https://systems-analysis.ru/books.html): Book and literature catalog for systems analysis and related disciplines.
- [Russian publications](https://systems-analysis.ru/publications/): Original materials and translations on systems analysis, systems theory, operations research, expert methods, policy analysis, and disciplinary history.
- [Data Science — Russian](https://systems-analysis.ru/data_science.html): Static introduction to data science and its relationship to analysis, modeling, and decision-making.

## Static public site — Russian downloadable book catalogs
- [Systems-analysis books for download](https://systems-analysis.ru/systems_analysis_book.html): Dedicated download catalog of books and source materials on systems analysis and the systems approach, including classical monographs and issues of the “Systems Research” annual.
- [Operations-research books for download](https://systems-analysis.ru/operation_research_book.html): Dedicated download catalog of books and source materials on operations research, mathematical programming, statistical decision theory, and PERT and network-planning methods.

## English wiki — entry points and peer subject catalogs
- [English wiki main page](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Main_Page): Primary entry point to the English encyclopedic knowledge base.
- [English wiki master catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Systems_Analysis_Wiki_Catalog): Master table of contents connecting the principal English subject catalogs, semantic networks, and literature indexes.
- [Category:English — English wiki language count and index](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Category:English): Language-wide category for English-wiki content. The category header reports the current total number of pages assigned to English, including when the page list is split into batches of 200; use it for the classified English-language page count and broad language-wide discovery.
- [Systems approach — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Systems_approach%3A_Section_catalog): Systems thinking, systems theory, systems analysis, core concepts, and literature.
- [Operations research — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Operations_research%3A_Section_catalog): Optimization, mathematical programming, network models, simulation, and operations-research problem classes.
- [Decision theory — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Decision_theory%3A_Section_catalog): Decision problems, uncertainty, risk, alternatives, criteria, preferences, utility, and choice methods.
- [Machine learning and data analysis — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Machine_learning_and_data_analysis%3A_Section_catalog): Data analysis, statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, evaluation, and MLOps.
- [Large language models — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Large_language_models%3A_Section_catalog): LLM foundations, Transformer architectures, training, adaptation, context, safety, optimization, and multimodality.
- [Large language models — model catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Large_language_models%3A_Catalog): Model families, providers, open and closed ecosystems, and named LLM series.
- [Prompt engineering — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Prompt_engineering%3A_Section_catalog): Prompting methods, retrieval augmentation, reasoning patterns, agents, tool use, function calling, and GraphRAG.
- [Management — section index](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Management%3A_Section_Index): Management, planning, control, project management, risk management, organization, and decision support.
- [Systems engineering — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Systems_engineering%3A_Section_catalog): Systems-engineering concepts, life cycles, requirements, architecture, standards, processes, and management.
- [Strategic analysis — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Strategic_analysis%3A_Section_catalog): Strategic analysis, strategic management, planning, environment analysis, and related methods.
- [Methodology and epistemology — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Methodology_and_epistemology%3A_Section_catalog): Scientific methodology, epistemology, paradigms, reasoning, analysis methods, and interdisciplinary inquiry.
- [Modeling — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Modeling%3A_Section_catalog): General modeling concepts, model classifications, representation, simulation, verification, and validation.
- [Mathematical modeling — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Mathematical_modeling%3A_Section_catalog): Mathematical-model construction, identification, implementation, verification, validation, and interpretation.
- [Mathematics — section catalog](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Mathematics%3A_Section_catalog): Probability, statistics, analysis, algebra, logic, optimization, games, graphs, queues, and numerical methods.

- [Systems analysis — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Systems_analysis%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for systems-analysis concepts, stages, objects, goals, problems, and methods.

- [Systems engineering — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Systems_engineering%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for systems-engineering processes, requirements, life cycles, and architecture.
- [Operations research — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Operations_research%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for optimization, models, methods, and operations-research problem classes.
- [Decision theory — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Decision_theory%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for alternatives, criteria, uncertainty, risk, utility, preference, and choice.
- [Mathematical modeling — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Mathematical_modeling%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for mathematical models, construction, analysis, validation, and use.
- [Management — semantic network](https://systems-analysis.ru/eng/Management%3A_Semantic_network): Relationship map for management, planning, control, organization, projects, and risks.
